items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: And the organ player, Ed Bachelor(?) in Kansas City, put the money behind McShann.

ctx.x: And the organ player, Ed Bachelor(?) in Kansas City, put the money behind McShann. But he didn't stay with it. He didn't care no more. He just kept it right there in Kansas City. That's why he didn't do too good.
Are you suggesting that in order to become established, a musician had to go to New York?
